# witness — frontier design (WILDGROUND vision pass)

*Generated by a WILDGROUND pass (8 discovered vantages → taxonomy → one adversarial
unknown-unknowns critic → architect), 2026-08-13. This is the ambition map, not a
commitment to build all of it. v0 builds the floor.*

## The reframe

The primary artifact is **the recording (a "capsule")** — the real inputs + the
whole causal boundary a function touched + the observed output/effects. The
emitted `.py` test is a *disposable projection* of the capsule. That one shift
turns a test generator into a **governed behavioral oracle**.

## The grounding invariant (the spine)

> Every assertion `witness` commits must trace, by an immutable receipt, to a fact
> that was **actually observed** in a real execution and is **reproducible by
> construction**.

Enforced by one verification spine every capability routes through:
1. **Capture-Fidelity Contract** — a value becomes a fixture only if
   serialize → reconstruct → replay reproduces the observed path *and* output;
   inputs deep-copied at call **entry** (late mutation captured separately);
   generators/streams recorded as consumed prefix; identity/hash/ordering exposed
   by perturbation and quarantined. Non-certifiable → **refused**, logged, at most
   an inert TODO. **(This is v0.)**
2. **Volatility Triage** — run N times; per-field variance measured; stable → exact
   pin, volatile → tightest observation-backed matcher; variance itself flagged as
   a possible *defect*, never silently laundered.
3. **Schema Verdict** — content-addressed value shapes; cross-version compare is
   MATCH / BREAK / **DRIFT** (drift withholds, never coerces).
4. **Provenance + Lint** — every pin carries a receipt; a lint gate forbids the
   (optional) LLM layer from ever authoring a value; a Fossilization Guard
   quarantines outputs born amid a distress signal (swallowed exception, error log,
   NaN, retry) so bugs aren't canonized as truth.
5. **Re-Execution Sandbox** — any capability that runs code on a *non-recorded*
   input runs sealed, serves the boundary from the ledger, and **fails loud** on an
   unobserved crossing; any output it produces is a *new* real observed fact.

Motto: **observe freely; only the certified-observed is asserted; refusal is a
first-class, explainable output — not a silent guess.**

## Build order (architect's recommendation)

1. **Capsule Recorder + Capture-Fidelity Contract** — the floor / v0 crux. *(large)*
2. **Volatility Triage Engine** — anti-flake + defect guard. *(medium)*
3. **Hermetic Boundary Ledger + Secret/Effect pipeline** — the world becomes the mock. *(large)*
4. **Schema-Fingerprint + Three-Valued Replay Verdict** — MATCH/BREAK/DRIFT. *(medium)*
5. **Provenance Receipts + Fossilization Guard + Lint Gate** — trust made inspectable. *(medium)*
6. **Cross-Version Replay-Diff Oracle + Behavioral Bisect** — the headline: a self-maintaining regression suite; PR review becomes "approve these 3 behavior changes." *(medium)*
7. **Corpus Distillation + Readable Minimization** — 3.9M calls → 52 labeled representatives; ddmin big inputs to readable fixtures. *(medium)*
8. **Ratification Governor** — meter scarce human attention across all review surfaces. *(medium)*
9. **Bounded LLM Narration + True-Contract Portrait** — readable names/docstrings (never values); a queryable decision table of observed behavior. *(medium)*
10. **Negative-Space Coverage Map + Mutation-Survival Diagnostic** — make "green" honest: a map of what was never witnessed. *(medium)*
11. **Re-Execution Safety Sandbox** — the containment substrate for everything below. *(large)*
12. **Incident & Heisenbug Capture-to-Fixture** — a once-only crash is already sealed as a permanent regression. *(medium)*
13. **Stateful Sequence + Protocol-Automaton Capture** — capture trajectories, learn the protocol actually exercised. *(large)*
14. **Grounded Exploration + Fault Injection** — perturb-then-re-execute for real error-path coverage. *(large)*
15. **Observed-Invariant Mining** — conjecture laws that held in every observation; human ratifies; auto-demote on counterexample. *(medium)*
16. **Cross-Implementation Equivalence Oracle** — prove a refactor/rewrite/port didn't move behavior, over *real* inputs. *(large)*
17. **Production Traffic Harvesting + Structure-Preserving Redaction** — the category moat: tests reality wrote. *(large)*
18. **Shadow-Mode Live Oracle** — the blessed corpus as a live production sentinel. *(medium)*
19. **Cross-Service Distributed Capture + Auto-Derived Contracts** — one real request's fan-out as one offline integration test. *(large, not-now)*

`certify` · `snapshot-and-diff` (entry copy vs exit mutation) · `perturb-to-expose`
· `read-the-refusals` (absence of an assertion is a diagnostic) · `approve-these-
behavior-changes` · `behavioral git-bisect` · `three-valued-verdict` ·
`conjecture-ratify` · `budget-your-attention` · `shadow-sentinel` ·
`query-the-true-contract-portrait` · `grounded-perturb-then-re-execute`.

## The hard parts the critic verified (design around these)
- **Capture-time value semantics is the deepest hole** — a naive recorder captures
  *post*-mutation inputs, consumes lazy generators, or triggers new boundary
  crossings just by serializing a lazy ORM/proxy. Faithful serialization of
  arbitrary object graphs is the product's hardest core. (v0: deep-copy at entry +
  refuse-on-unfaithful.)
- **Fail-loud vs re-execute** — exploration/fault-injection/ddmin run code on
  non-recorded inputs; without the sandbox they either abort or fire real side
  effects. (v0 caveat: certification re-invokes, so side-effecting functions run
  twice — document it; the ledger+sandbox fix it later.)
- **Volatility triage can launder a real race** into an "incidental field" — treat
  measured variance as a *defect candidate*.
- **Async/concurrent capture** has no total order to record — an admitted coverage
  boundary, not solved by `sys.monitoring`.
- **Secrets/PII in the boundary ledger** committed to git forever — a security/legal
  blocker needing a redaction pipeline that *re-validates replay still holds*.
- **Recording-as-artifact is an uncosted storage problem** — distillation/ddmin
  mitigate; raw capture IO is real.
- **Human-attention bankruptcy** — the documented way these tools die; the
  Ratification Governor is load-bearing, not optional.
